q1.question: How do I add images?
q1.answer: You can simply drag and drop images into the designated area or click the "Select Files" button to upload them from your device.

q2.question: How can I edit a single image?
q2.answer: Click the magic wand button () on an image card. A window will open with all editing options.

q3.question: How do I save the edited images?
q3.answer: Select the desired images by clicking on their cards, then click "Save As…" in the top bar.

q4.question: Which image formats are supported?
q4.answer: The application supports PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, and GIF, depending on your browser's capabilities.

q5.question: Can I download multiple images as a ZIP file?
q5.answer: Yes. Select the images and click the "ZIP" button in the toolbar.

q6.question: How do I create a PDF file from my images?
q6.answer: You can export either all images or selected ones as PDF using the respective buttons.

q7.question: What happens if I close the browser window?
q7.answer: All images are stored locally, so they will be lost if you close the window. Save your work regularly.

q8.question: How do I remove images from the list?
q8.answer: Click the red X icon on individual cards or use the "Delete" button for multiple selections.

learn.title: Web Audio API, Vue.js 3 & Modern Browser Technologies
learn.subtitle: A comprehensive learning resource for developers who want to understand and apply modern web technologies. From audio processing to reactive UI frameworks to performance optimization.

intro.p1: Modern web applications use a variety of browser APIs to implement powerful features directly in the client. This guide walks you through the most important technologies.
intro.p2: Whether you want to create audio visualizations, process images, or build reactive user interfaces – you'll find the necessary knowledge here.

webaudio.title: Web Audio API
webaudio.intro: The Web Audio API is a powerful browser API for audio processing and synthesis. It enables complex audio effects, visualizations, and real-time audio manipulation.

basics.title: Core Concepts
basics.text: The Web Audio API is based on a modular routing system. Audio nodes are connected together to form a processing graph.

concepts.context: The central coordinator for all audio operations. Manages the audio graph and timing.
concepts.node: Building blocks of audio processing: Sources, Effects, Analyzers, and Destination.
concepts.buffer: Container for audio data in memory. Enables efficient playback and manipulation.
concepts.param: Automatable parameters for precise control of volume, frequency, and more.

analyser.title: Audio Analysis and Visualization
analyser.text: With the AnalyserNode, you can extract frequency and time domain data for use in visualizations.

webaudio.tip: AudioContext must be started by user interaction (e.g., click) since browsers block autoplay.

vue3.title: Vue.js 3 Composition API
vue3.intro: Vue.js 3 introduces the Composition API, enabling more flexible and reusable code organization.
vue3.optionsApi: Classic approach with data, methods, computed. Good for simple components.
vue3.compositionApi: Modern approach with setup(), ref(), reactive(). Ideal for complex logic and reusability.

reactivity.title: Reactivity System
reactivity.text: Vue 3 uses a Proxy-based reactivity system that automatically tracks dependencies and triggers updates.

composables.title: Creating Composables
composables.text: Composables are reusable functions that encapsulate reactive logic. They follow the use* naming convention.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle Hooks
lifecycle.mounted: DOM is ready, initialize external APIs

canvas.title: Canvas API for Image Processing
canvas.intro: The Canvas API enables pixel-perfect image manipulation directly in the browser. Ideal for filters, transformations, and real-time effects.

features.drawDesc: Draw shapes, lines, text, and complex paths.
features.imageDesc: Load, transform, and edit images pixel by pixel.
features.exportDesc: Export as PNG, JPEG, or WebP.

canvas.warning: For large images, Canvas processing can block the main thread. Consider Web Workers for intensive operations.

fileapi.title: File API & Blob Handling
fileapi.intro: The File API provides access to user-selected files. Together with Blob and URL.createObjectURL, it forms the foundation for file-based web applications.
fileapi.file: Represents a file with metadata like name, size, and MIME type.
fileapi.reader: Reads file contents as text, ArrayBuffer, or Data URL.
fileapi.blob: Raw data container for binary data of any kind.
fileapi.objecturl: Creates a temporary URL for Blob objects for display or download.

typescript.title: TypeScript in Vue 3
typescript.intro: TypeScript provides static typing for JavaScript, improving the developer experience through better autocompletion, refactoring, and error detection.

pinia.title: State Management with Pinia
pinia.intro: Pinia is the official state management solution for Vue 3. It offers an intuitive API, full TypeScript support, and DevTools integration.

workers.title: Web Workers for Performance
workers.intro: Web Workers enable JavaScript execution in background threads without blocking the main thread. Ideal for intensive computations.

types.dedicated: Dedicated thread for compute-intensive tasks like image processing.
types.shared: Can be shared across multiple browsing contexts.
types.service: For offline functionality, caching, and push notifications.

workers.tip: Use Transferable Objects for large data buffers to avoid copying costs.

performance.title: Performance Optimization
performance.intro: A fast application significantly improves user experience. These techniques help optimize Vue applications.

lazy.title: Lazy Loading
lazy.desc: Load components and routes only when needed.

virtual.title: Virtual Scrolling
virtual.desc: Render only visible items in long lists.

memo.title: Memoization
memo.desc: Cache expensive computations with computed() and v-memo.

debounce.title: Debouncing
debounce.desc: Batch frequent events for fewer updates.

security.title: Web Application Security
security.intro: Security is a critical aspect of any web application. These best practices help avoid common vulnerabilities.

csp.title: Content Security Policy
csp.desc: HTTP headers to control allowed resources.

xss.title: XSS Prevention
xss.desc: Vue escapes automatically, but v-html requires caution.

clientSide.title: Client-Side Processing
clientSide.text: Maximum privacy through local data processing. No data leaves the browser, no server uploads required.

practice.title: Practical Exercises
practice.intro: Put what you've learned into practice. These exercises help solidify the concepts.

audio.title: Audio Player with Visualization
audio.desc: Create a simple audio player with frequency visualization.

gallery.title: Image Gallery with Filters
gallery.desc: A Vue 3 component for image display with Canvas filters.
gallery.task3: Create Pinia store for image management

visualizer.title: Real-Time Audio Visualizer
visualizer.desc: Combine Web Audio API with Canvas for impressive visualizations.
visualizer.task2: Use FFT data for spectrum analysis

conclusion.title: Summary
conclusion.text: You now have a comprehensive overview of modern web technologies. These concepts form the foundation for powerful browser applications.
